answer_2.quote: we also perform an automatic evaluation by transcribing system outputs with a large-vocabulary automatic speech recognition (ASR) system

answer_4.quote: The human evaluator is given a set of 20 audio output files from each model being tested and is asked to write out in words what they heard.
answer_4.guideline: Please listen to each of the attached sound files and write down what you hear as best you can. ... Write your transcriptions ... If you cannot make out any words, leave the corresponding row blank.
